replication.target_description: Single Bayesian reasoning conceptual replication; 75 undergraduate teacher students; interaction of order of phases and type of instruction effect on procedural knowledge; two-factor rank transformation test.

n.location: p. 1751 (PDF p. 13), Table 7, Sample column; Table 5 note on inclusion
n.sample_role: Undergraduate teacher students in learning-outcome analysis
n.exclusions: All 75 included in learning-outcome analyses; one missing demographic questionnaire did not exclude that student (Table 5 note).

notes: Original acquisition: publisher preview only; no verified target full text. ResearchGate page advertised the target title but its available full text was a different 2019 paper, rejected. No values derived or converted. Replication verdict is the authors’ overall replication verdict; the type/interaction procedural effects were not separately hypothesized. Replication uses its prespecified conceptual-knowledge ANOVA or procedural-knowledge rank transformation test; parallel conceptual rank-test results were not substituted.
